A+ Core 2 220-1202 Practice Test and Study Guide

APlus Academy Core 2 is a free A+ Core 2 220-1202 practice test and study guide course: forty-one lessons on operating systems, security, software troubleshooting, and operational procedures, a printable memorization sheet, tutorials built from your misses, and unlimited practice tests. Use it as an A+ 220-1202 study guide on its own, or work through the CompTIA A+ Core 2 practice questions bank lesson by lesson.

ExamCompTIA A+ Core 2
Code220-1202
Questions90
Time90 minutes
PassingThe real exam passes at 700 on a 100 to 900 scale. This course's official-format test uses 78%, that score divided by 900.
Course41 lessons across 9 units, about 6.8 hours of reading
CostFree

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 90 questions in 90 minutes, at its real passing score of 78%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the A+ Core 2 exam?

Up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, multiple choice and performance-based. The passing score is 700 on a scale of 100 to 900.

What does Core 2 cover?

Operating systems, security, software troubleshooting, and operational procedures, including scripting, remote access, and backups.

How much does A+ cost?

See CompTIA's current voucher price for each exam; the course is free.

How does the course decide I am ready?

Three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one ninety-question test at the real passing score of 700 of 900.
